decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX carries high sunk costs and visible public commitment from its renaming and launch, so management attributes any disappointing results to temporary causes and persists.
As a multi-model grinder line with substantial investment and public segment commitment, escalation favors retaining it despite any unobserved weak outcomes.
The green-waste grinder aligns with the announced resource-saving direction and has accumulated investments, leading management to justify continued commitment and keep it.
